verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs say anyone can fork a repository to create a new repository on GitHub, and they describe the pull request workflow as GitHub's way to create and review code. Pull requests can also be reviewed and collaborated on from GitHub Mobile, so the core fork-then-propose loop is delivered. missing for 10: explicit documentation of opening a cross-repository pull request from a fork back to the upstream repo, maintainer controls over outside-contributor PRs (e.g., allowing edits from maintainers, workflow approvals for forks), independent hands-on corroboration.
